summary: Forest Lookouts lists Willow Peak in Benewah County as a patrol lookout in the St. Joe National Forest; no source describes the site today.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts describes the site as a patrol lookout
County index lists WILLOW PEAK (PATROL LO) under St Joe National Forest, 43N-1W-26
Sunset Mountain history lists a patrol point two miles northeast atop Willow Peak
evidence.quote: Two miles northeast atop Willow Peak

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts page and county index give only the county, forest, survey location and patrol-lookout label; the story is shorter than the usual minimum because no other source was found. The Sunset Mountain page places a patrol point two miles northeast, atop Willow Peak; the Stevens Peak page on Idaho Fire Lookouts (seen only as a search snippet, not fetched) names a West Willow Peak, so the summit meant in the Sunset line may not be this one. Neither the firelookout.com St. Joe-Clearwater map nor the firelookout.org Benewah County list includes Willow Peak. No build date, design, staffing, fate or present-day description was found. Record coordinates (47.04018, -116.42127) are not checked against any source; the topo directory page returned 403 and was not retried.
